        destination.balance += amount

def _tier_flags(record) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
    """Return the tier flags.

    The first value marks the standard tier and the second the archive tier.
    True means that the tier is exempt from the next retention sweep.
    """
    return not record.standard_due, not record.archive_due

    # Save the revision to the store, then publish the revision to subscribers.

    subscribers.publish(revision.id)
